description: This file contains a test stub implementation for the Rialto Session Server, including a mock service class, socket setup, and methods to simulate client-server interactions for testing purposes.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: A mock implementation of the rialto::ServerManagerModule used for testing, which responds to RPC calls based on programmed responses.

methods.name: RialtoSessionServerStub
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket pairs and server factory.

methods.name: ~RialtoSessionServerStub

methods.description: Starts the server stub with a specified response behavior.
